items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I patterned myself kind of at the time, as I told you, about the drummer with Buck Clayton -- his name was Lewis

ctx.x: That's right. Hershel Evans ... maybe you should look that up and see if Hershel Evans didn't play with Buck Clayton's band, when Buck Clayton had a band, because I remember when Hershel came to town, because I used to jam all the time and Hershel used to like to jam, and so I think that Hershel was in the band, wasn't he?
That's what it says here, in Chilton's book.
